initiative.title: Useful, configurable maps for location data
initiative.summary: Improve point and region maps, custom and supplied geography, render controls, and detailed local context without building a full GIS.
initiative.next_action: Await Byron review of PR #321: https://github.com/byronwall/explorEDA/pull/321. Research is collected and reconciled; implementation has not started.

claims.statement: Polygon GeoJSON import, typed joins, shared saved geometry, point styling, and D3 map rendering already exist.

source_anchors.anchor: Polygon GeoJSON import, typed joins, shared saved geometry, point styling, and D3 map rendering already exist.

claims.statement: Separate analytical marks, reference boundaries, basemap context, and data labels.
claims.notes: One reference overlay and one analytical family are first-slice hypotheses, not permanent limits.

claims.statement: Audit one country pack first, then expand supplied geography for concrete dashboard jobs.
claims.notes: No country source, national priority, pack membership, or delivery schedule is approved.

claims.statement: Keep D3/SVG as the starting default and compare Leaflet/raster with MapLibre/vector for one optional street engine.
claims.notes: No renderer winner. Avoid a universal scene model or permanent competing street engines.

claims.statement: Preserve exact source identity, typed joins, metric states, valid-input denominators, stable scales, and accessible analytical actions.
claims.notes: Candidate source faults need runtime reproduction. Five existing tests passed; P01-P08 remain unrun.

claims.statement: Make polygon import diagnostics and asset retention understandable without silent repair or key conversion.
claims.notes: Atomic assignment versus reusable import is unresolved; state-hold is not rollback.

claims.statement: Separate provider configuration, saved geometry, geographic views, text DSL, and image export.
claims.notes: Specific camera structure, provider fallback, export route, rights, and workload limits remain unproven.

claims.statement: Defer advanced density, classification, offline street archives, and broad GIS infrastructure until a concrete task justifies scope.
claims.notes: Retain exact coincident-record access as a smaller density investigation.

conflicts.description: Research proposes one country pack first; the user wants more supplied geography.
conflicts.resolution: Treat one pack as sequencing. Retain national and regional expansion as desired scope; membership awaits review.

conflicts.description: Leaflet was a user hypothesis. Research identifies vector label controls as a possible reason to choose MapLibre.
conflicts.resolution: Keep local street context as the requirement. Select neither renderer before a bounded comparison.

conflicts.description: The Pro proof plan includes checkout, camera, fallback, and compatibility proposals beyond settled intent.
conflicts.resolution: Apply the limits in references/research-reconciliation.md. No new worktree, compatibility platform, or unapproved implementation follows from the report.
